extDescription.message: Show two subtitles at once on YouTube: pick a primary and a secondary track, styled with your YouTube caption settings.

popupSecondaryHint.message: Auto: the original language when YouTube auto-translates, otherwise your preferred language.

popupFooter.message: Turn dual subtitles on or off in YouTube's Settings → Subtitles/CC. Pick two tracks there in turn: the current one is the primary, the previous one the secondary. Font, colours and background follow YouTube's caption settings.
